_comment: Issue #3607: the one owner-facing wording table for a Codex policy hold. The Go CLI (apitypes) and the web (web/src/lib) each carry a copy pinned to this file by a test; the DTO's hold_cause and resume_modes are the keys.

causes.refused: The provider refused a request under its usage policy.
causes.attempt_path: This pickup cannot continue the old conversation on this lane; continuing needs a fresh conversation from the saved work.
causes.saved_work_missing: The required saved work was not found where this pickup ran; nothing was started.
causes.session_missing: The saved conversation is not available where this pickup ran; nothing was started.
causes.transcript_unknown: The saved conversation's transcript could not be confirmed where this pickup ran; nothing was started.
causes.provider_resume_rejected: The provider rejected resuming the saved conversation.
causes.pending_conversion: An earlier refusal recorded on the worker was converted into this hold.
causes.fresh_start_uncertain: A one-claim fresh start was used but never confirmed; a provider conversation may already exist.

preserve.label: Resume the preserved conversation
preserve.consequence: Continues the same conversation with your guidance. If the conversation is missing or rejected, the run is held again; it never starts a new conversation.

fresh_from_saved_work.label: Fresh conversation from the saved work
fresh_from_saved_work.consequence: Starts a fresh conversation from the saved work and resolves this refusal. Any earlier requirement to preserve the old conversation ends for the rest of the run, until a new refusal.

fresh_one_claim.label: Fresh conversation for one pickup
fresh_one_claim.consequence: Lets exactly the next pickup start one new conversation from the saved work. Later pickups preserve that new conversation again; a fresh start that is never confirmed is held, not repeated.
